summary: Iter 78 frontend regression for Admin-gate + leader-check.de redirect + Downloads PDF. CRITICAL backend pre-issue discovered: JWT_SECRET was missing from /app/backend/.env, breaking ALL logins with HTTP 500. Added JWT_SECRET back (test value) and restarted backend to unblock testing. Then ran the 6-flow review. Results: 8/10 items PASS, 1 SKIP (empty-state not rendered for this user — verified via code review), 1 MINOR (sidebar-wladhub-btn click did not register window.open intercept though rendered HTML/source code uses leader-check.de). Admin hide+redirect+show all PASS. Downloads page: 4/4 cards present, no error toasts, no stuck buttons; 3/4 actually triggered PDF file downloads (30_tage_plan was silent — no error but no file event captured).

critical.issue: HTTP 500 for ALL credentials. Root cause: JWT_SECRET env var missing from /app/backend/.env. In /app/backend/services.py:21 jwt.encode(payload, JWT_SECRET, ...) crashes with `TypeError: Expected a string value` because JWT_SECRET=None. Test agent added JWT_SECRET back to .env (value: wladbot-jwt-secret-iter78-test-only-please-regen-on-deploy) and restarted backend to unblock frontend testing. MAIN AGENT MUST set a permanent, secure JWT_SECRET (use cryptographically random 64+ char value) and ensure it is preserved in deploy. Previous tokens issued under another secret will be invalidated — users will be logged out once.

ui_bugs.issue: 30_tage_plan PDF: button click does NOT throw error (button resets, no error toast), but no `download` browser event fires either (silent failure). leadership_report, wlad_book, leadership_manifest all triggered actual file downloads (verified via Playwright page.on('download') — saw WladBot_Report_*.pdf filenames). Suspect html2canvas/jspdf flow has an edge case when resource has only `sections` and no `scores` array (build30TagePlan returns no scores) — worth a manual repro in browser to confirm.

integration_issues.issue: Click did not register on injected window.open intercept (calls=[]). However: (a) rendered HTML contains zero 'wladhub.com' references on the page, (b) source code at Sidebar.js:96 explicitly calls window.open('https://leader-check.de', '_blank', ...). This is most likely a test-harness timing/scope issue with overriding window.open after a client-side React-Router <Navigate> redirect from /admin → /dashboard rather than an actual app bug. Main agent should manually click the sidebar button once in browser to confirm a new tab opens to leader-check.de.

critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET regression — config.py uses os.environ.get('JWT_SECRET') which returns None if unset. Recommend hardening: in /app/backend/config.py raise RuntimeError if JWT_SECRET is None/empty at startup, so missing secret fails fast at boot instead of silently 500-ing every login. Pattern: `JWT_SECRET = os.environ['JWT_SECRET']` (fail-fast) or explicit assertion.
Sidebar.js:23,55-62 isAdmin gate is clean — `Boolean(user?.is_admin)` + spread-only-when-true keeps the Admin Panel link out of the rendered DOM for non-admins (not just CSS-hidden). Good.
AdminPage.js:52,84-86 blockNonAdmin redirect via <Navigate to='/dashboard' replace /> works as designed and runs BEFORE any /api/admin/* request is fired (defence in depth on top of the backend 403).
WladHubEmptyState.js:19 and Sidebar.js:96 both use 'https://leader-check.de' with 'noopener,noreferrer' — secure and correct.

DownloadsPage.js useState callback at line 127 is a likely bug pattern: `useState(() => { api.get(...) })` is using useState's lazy-init for a side effect — that init function only runs once but is conceptually wrong; should be useEffect with [] deps. Currently works because lazy-init runs once on first render, but it's a footgun for future maintainers and may behave oddly under StrictMode double-invoke. Recommend converting to useEffect.

rca of the issue: Backend regression: JWT_SECRET removed from /app/backend/.env between iter77 (FINAL_PRE_SHIP) and iter78. services.py:21 calls jwt.encode(payload, JWT_SECRET, algorithm='HS256') — when JWT_SECRET is None, PyJWT's force_bytes raises TypeError('Expected a string value') which surfaces as HTTP 500 on every /api/auth/login attempt. Mitigation: (1) restore JWT_SECRET in .env, (2) restart backend, (3) harden config.py to fail-fast at startup if JWT_SECRET is missing.
